2010_010_092110regmtg.paragraph: Board packet for the Troy School District Board of Education regular meeting of Tuesday, September 21, 2010 at 7:00 p.m. in the Services Building, 4420 Livernois, Troy, Michigan, carrying the agenda, minutes of the September 7 board meeting and September 14 workshop, the August 2010 Treasurer's Report with its Pentamation check register, wire transfers and ACH debits, the August year-to-date FY2011 budget reports, and items on negotiating teams, professional development and MASB delegates. Total disbursements in the period were $6,896,255.46. The General Fund statement shows an original budget of $134,308,608 in revenue against $135,793,505 in expenditures, with fund balance carried from $18,120,438 on July 1, 2010 to $16,635,541 on June 30, 2011.

**Meeting**
Troy School District Board of Education, Regular Meeting, Tuesday, September 21, 2010, 7:00 PM, Services Building, 4420 Livernois, Troy, Michigan 48098; district masthead 4400 Livernois, 248.823.4000. Meetings are cablecast on TS-TV Channel 19 (Comcast) and Channel 15 (WOW) every Monday and Wednesday at 2:00 and 9:00 p.m., except July and August. Recognition introduces first-semester student representatives Bria Ellis, an Athens High School senior, and Andrew Michail, Troy High School junior class president.

**September 7, 2010 minutes**
President Underwood convened at 7:00 p.m. with Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff, Miletti, Philippart and Pochodylo present. **Identification**
Troy School District Board of Education, Regular Meeting, Tuesday, September 21, 2010, 7:00 PM, Services Building, 4420 Livernois, Troy, Michigan 48098; district masthead 4400 Livernois, 248.823.4000. Meetings are cablecast on TS-TV Channel 19 (Comcast) and Channel 15 (WOW) every Monday and Wednesday at 2:00 and 9:00 p.m. except July and August. The consent agenda carries the September 7 minutes, the September 14 workshop minutes and the August 2010 Treasurer's Report; later items are the Board Negotiating Team report, Professional Development for 2010/2011, MASB delegate certification and a closed session. First-semester student representatives Bria Ellis of Athens High School and Andrew Michail of Troy High School are introduced.

**Minutes, Board of Education meeting, September 7, 2010**
President Underwood called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m.; Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff, Miletti, Philippart and Pochodylo were present, with Superintendent Fowler, administrators Birmingham, Bryan, Keeling, Machesky, Miller, Rajter, Stromayer and Witt, and approximately 8 audience members. The board recognized Mark Martin (Boulan Park Middle School), Melissa Rehbine (Smith Middle School) and Jennifer Slade (Larson Middle School) as winners of the 2010 Edyth May Sliffe Award for Distinguished Middle School Mathematics Teaching, and noted that for the 21st straight year the district earned the Association of School Business Officials' International Certificate of Excellence in Financial Reporting for its Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2009. Recess ran 7:10 p.m. to 7:15 p.m.
Resolution 10-093 (Philippart/Fleming) approved minutes of the August 17, 2010 Special Board of Education Workshop and the August 17, 2010 Board of Education Meeting, Ayes 7 / Nays 0. Resolution 10-094 (Pochodylo/Hauff) approved personnel recommendations, new hires Anne Costello, Garrett Lovas, Katie Oxendine, Nathan Reynolds, Sara Seckel, Kara Spodarek and Sarah Young, Ayes 7 / Nays 0. Bob Stromayer, Director of Continuing Education, gave a summer 2010 program update; Jan Keeling and Richard Machesky presented enrollment as of September 7, 2010; Mark Rajter and Ken Miller presented a slide show on completion of the summer 2010 bond projects.
Resolution 10-095 (Edmunds/Philippart) awarded music instrument bids to A & G Central Music, Sam Ash Quickstop, Shar Products Co., Taylor Music, Inc. and Washington Music Center from the 2004 Capital Projects Fund, $31,879.00 for I.A.E. and $32,208.00 for elementary, $64,087.00 in all; Ayes 7 / Nays 0. Resolution 10-096 (Philippart/Edmunds) approved secondary science supplies including Pasco Scientific $9,236.34 and Sargent Welch $17,878.04, totaling $1,301.82 General Fund and $39,776.96 Capital Projects Fund, $41,078.78 in all; Ayes 7 / Nays 0. Resolution 10-097 (Hauff/Fleming) awarded the Apple iPad bid to Apple, Inc. for $24,158.47 from the 2004 Capital Projects Fund. Resolution 10-098 (Fleming/Edmunds) took the board into closed session on negotiations under the Michigan Open Meetings Act, Public Act 267, Section 8(h), roll call all Yes, carried 7-0; closed session began at 8:15 p.m., the meeting reconvened at 9:09 p.m. and adjourned at 9:10 p.m. Submitted by Nancy L. Philippart, Secretary.

**Minutes, Board Workshop, September 14, 2010**
Vice-President Miletti called the workshop to order at 6:00 p.m. at the Administration Building with Edmunds, Hauff, Philippart and Pochodylo; Underwood and Fleming absent. Administrators present: Fowler, Birmingham, Keeling, Machesky, Rajter, Hosang and Mrs. Buchanan of Smith Middle School; Rhonda Hendrickson, President of Friends of the Troy Public Library, attended for the millage discussion. Items: grading pilot at Smith Middle School; staffing, enrollment and schools of choice; school funding; sale of district property; MASB Fall Conference (November 4-7, 2010) delegates; library millage proposal. Adjourned 8:49 p.m.

**Item 6.A - Board Negotiating Teams**
The collective bargaining agreement with TEA/MEA/NEA, representing the teaching staff, expires August 14, 2011; the agreement with TESA/MEA/NEA, representing the secretarial staff, expires June 30, 2011. The resolution names Jasen Witt chief spokesperson for both, with Mark Rajter, Jan Keeling and Richard Machesky on the TEA team and Mark Rajter, Richard Machesky and Bonnie Lobert on the TESA team, and states the board's desire to reach a fair and equitable agreement with each association.

**Item 7.A - Professional Development for 2010/2011**
Report by Mrs. Anne Mull, Director of Instruction and Assessment, on planning begun in spring 2010: Atlas Rubicon for curriculum documents; secondary math alignment to the common core; elementary reading curriculum work; school improvement plans all submitted; KALPA with principals and secretaries; TransACT with administrators and secretaries; SIOP with secondary administrators and with 30 secondary teachers; McDougal Littell for administrators and for ELA grades 9-12; elementary TALL participants facilitating September 1 grade level meetings with building NCA; September 2 reading and common assessment meetings for grades 3-5 and reading, math and science for grades K-2; Follett training for media specialists; special education ancillary staff training on Autism Spectrum Disorders; and four secondary sessions at Troy High on September 1.

**Items 10.A and 11.A**
A resolution certifies Mrs. Ida Edmunds, Mrs. Paula Fleming and Ms. Nancy Philippart as delegates to the Michigan Association of School Boards 2010 Delegate Assembly on November 4, 2010 during the MASB Fall Conference, certified by Nancy L. Philippart, Secretary. A further resolution takes the board into closed session on negotiations as permitted in the Michigan Open Meetings Act, Public Act 267, Section 8(c), with roll call listing Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff, Miletti, Philippart, Pochodylo and Underwood.
